title: SEKA SPEAR current manufacturer page recheck
notes: Current SPEAR page supports BSA threaded 68 mm, TeXtreme and ultra-high-modulus pitch-based carbon descriptions, and one-piece molding. It lists five standard and two racing sizes. It distinguishes an RDC 685 g claim from standard 780 g and separately shows 729 +/- 35 g for an M Shadow Black frame; size, paint and inclusion bases are not interchangeable or sufficiently clear to map the latter to the candidate's MR frame.
